segments.orig:
(zôt u râspî,) ahurâi mazdâi
haomã âvaêdhayamahî, (zôt,) imã
haomãsca myazdãsca zaothråsca baresmaca ashaya
frastaretem gãmca hudhånghem imãmcâ
gãm jîvyãm ashaya uzdâtãm imãmcâ
urvarãm hadhânaêpatãm ashaya uzdâtãm.
segments.en:
(And having approached these Haomas with our worship), we
present them to Ahura Mazda; (yea, we present) these Haomas, Myazdas,
Zaothras, and the Baresman spread with punctilious sanctity, and
the flesh, and the milk, fresh as if living, and lifted up with
punctilious sanctity, and this branch the Hadhanaepata likewise
lifted up with-sanctity.
segments.zh: （我們以崇拜接近這些豪麻），我們將它們獻給阿胡拉‧馬茲達；（是的，我們獻上）這些豪麻、妙食、祖特拉斯，以及以嚴謹的聖潔舖開的巴爾斯曼，還有肉，和奶，新鮮如活物，並以嚴謹的聖潔舉起，還有這枝哈達納埃帕塔枝，同樣以聖潔舉起。

segments.orig:
aiwyô vanguhibyô imå zaothrå haomavaitîsh
gaomavaitîsh hadhânaêpatavaitîsh ashaya
uzdâtå aiwyô vanguhibyô apemca haomyãm
asmanaca hâvana ayanghaênaca hâvana,
segments.en:
(And having approached these Zaothras in our worship), we
present them to the good waters having the Haoma with them, and
the milk, and the Hadhanaepata, and lifted up with scrupulous
sanctity; and (with them) we present the Haoma-water to the good
waters, and both the stone and the iron mortar.
segments.zh: （我們以崇拜接近這些祖特拉斯），我們將它們獻給善水，連同豪麻、奶，和哈達納埃帕塔，並以嚴謹的聖潔舉起；（連同它們）我們將豪麻水獻給善水，以及石臼和鐵臼。

segments.orig:
imãmcâ urvarãm baresmanîm jakhmûshîmca
ratufritîm marethremca varezîmca daênayå
vanghuyå mâzdayasnôish gâthanãmca
sraothrem jakhmûshîmca ashaonô ashahe rathwô
ratufritîm imã aêsmãsca baoidhîmca
tava âthrô ahurahe mazdå puthra vîspaca
vohu mazdadhâta ashacithra pairica dademahî âca
vaêdhayamahî âat dîsh âvaêdhayamahî,
segments.en:
And we present this plant of the Baresman! and the timely
prayer for blessings, which has approached in the due course of
the ritual, and the recollection and practice of the good Mazdayasnian
Religion, and the heard recital of the Gathas, and the timely
prayer for blessings which has approached as the prayer of the
holy lord of the ritual order; and these wood-billets, and the
perfume, (even) thine, the Fire's, O Ahura Mazda's son! and all
good objects Mazda-made, which have the seed of righteousness,
we offer and present.
segments.zh:
我們獻上這巴爾塞斯曼枝！以及應時的
祈福之禱，它已按儀式的
程序臨近，以及對善良的馬茲達教
的憶念與奉行，以及聽聞之伽薩誦讀，以及應時的
祈福之禱，它已作為儀式秩序之聖主的
祈禱而臨近；以及這些木柴，以及
香，乃至你的，火的，阿胡拉‧馬茲達的兒子啊！以及一切
馬茲達所造的善物，具有正義之種子的，
我們奉獻並呈上。

segments.orig:
ahurâica mazdâi sraoshâica ashyâi
ameshaêibyasca speñtaêibyô ashâunãmca
fravashibyô ashâunãmca urvôibyô
âthraêca ahurahe mazdå rathwaêca berezaite
vîspayå sãcatca ashaonô stôish
ýasnâica vahmâica xshnaothrâica frasastayaêca.
segments.en:
And these we present hereby to Ahura
Mazda, and to Sraosha (Obedience) the blessed (and Righteous),
and to the Bountiful Immortals; and to the Fravashis of the saints,
even to the souls of the saints, and to the Fire of Ahura Mazda,
the lofty lord of entire holy creation, for sacrifice, homage,
propitiation, and for praise.
segments.zh: 這些我們藉此獻給阿胡拉‧馬茲達，並獻給斯魯沙（順從）那有福的（與正義的），並獻給不朽聖者；並獻給聖者的弗拉瓦希，甚至聖者的靈魂，並獻給阿胡拉‧馬茲達之火，那整個神聖造物的崇高主宰，為了犧牲、崇敬、撫慰，並為了讚美。

segments.orig:
âat dîsh âvaêdhayamahî zarathushtrahe
spitâmahe ashaonô fravashêe ýasnâica
vahmâica xshnaothrâica frasastayaêca anghuyaosh
ashacinanghô mat vîspâbyô ashaonibyô
fravashibyô ýå irîrithushãm ashaonãm
ýåsca jvañtãm ashaonãm ýåsca
narãm azâtanãm frashô-carethrãm
saoshyañtãm!
segments.en:
And these we present hereby to the Fravashi of Zarathushtra
Spitama, the saint, for sacrifice, propitiation, and for praise,
and to that of the people who love Righteousness, with all the
holy Fravashis of the saints who are dead and who are living,
and to those of men who are as yet unborn, and to those of the
prophets who will serve us, and will labor to complete the progress
and renovation of the world.
segments.zh: 這些我們藉此獻給查拉圖斯特拉‧斯皮塔瑪的弗拉瓦希，那聖者，為了犧牲、撫慰，並為了讚美，並獻給那愛正義之民的弗拉瓦希，連同所有聖者的神聖弗拉瓦希，無論已死的和活著的，並獻給尚未出生的男人們的弗拉瓦希，並獻給那些將服務我們的先知們的弗拉瓦希，他們將勞作以完成世界的進步與更新。

segments.orig:
imã haomãsca myazdãsca zaothråsca
baresmaca ashaya frastaretem gãmca hudhånghem imãmcâ
gãm jîvyãm ashaya uzdâtãm imãmcâ
urvarãm hadhânaêpatãm ashaya uzdâtãm,
segments.en:
And we present these Haomas, Myazdas, Zaothras, and the Baresman
spread with sanctity, and the flesh, and the milk (fresh as if)
living, and lifted up with sanctity, and the Hadhanaepata branch.
segments.zh: 我們獻上這些豪麻、妙食、祖特拉斯，以及以聖潔舖開的巴爾斯曼，還有肉，和奶（新鮮如）活物，並以聖潔舉起，還有哈達納埃帕塔枝。

segments.orig:
aiwyô vanguhibyô imå zaothrå haomavaitîsh
gaomavaitîsh hadhânaêpatavaitîsh ashaya
uzdâtå aiwyô vanguhibyô apemca haomyãm
asmanaca hâvana ayanghaênaca hâvana,
segments.en:
And we present these Zaothras to the beneficial waters having
the Haoma with them, and the flesh, and the Hadhanaepata lifted
up with sanctity, and the Haoma-water, to the good waters, with
the stone and iron mortars, (8) and this plant of the Baresman,
(and) the tirnely Prayer and the recollection and practice of
the good Mazdayasnian Faith, and these wood-billets, and the perfume,
thine, the Fire's, O Ahura Mazda's son! and all objects which
are Mazda-made, and which have, and are, the seed of Righteousness,
these we offer and present.
segments.zh:
我們將這些祖斯拉獻給有益之水，
連同其中的豪麻、肉，以及以聖潔舉起的哈達納埃帕塔，
還有豪麻水，獻給善水，
連同石臼和鐵臼，（8）以及這巴雷斯曼枝條，
（以及）應時的祈禱，和對良善的馬茲達信仰的憶念與實踐，
以及這些木柴，和香料，
你的，火的，啊，阿胡拉‧馬茲達之子啊！以及一切物體，
凡馬茲達所造，具有且是正義的種子者，
這些我們奉獻並呈上。

segments.orig:
ameshaêibyô speñtaêibyô huxshathraêibyô
hudhåbyô ýavaêjibyô ýavaêsubyô
ýôi vanghêush â-mananghô shyeiñti
ýåsca uiti.
segments.en:
(Yea,) we present these hereby to the Bountiful Immortals
who rule aright, and who dispose of all aright, the ever-living,
ever-helpful, who abide with the Good Mind (of the Lord and of
His folk)!
<H2 id=y25
segments.zh: （是的，）我們藉此將這些獻給不朽聖者，他們公正統治，並公正處置一切，永遠活著，永遠助人，他們與善心（之主及其民）同在！

segments.orig:
âat dîsh âvaêdhayamahî frâyehîsh
ahe nmânahe fradathâi ahe nmânahe pasvãmca
narãmca zâtanãmca zãhyamnanãmca
ashaonãm ýenghe aêm heñti.
segments.en:
And we announce them in our celebrations as more propitious
for this house, and for the furtherance of this house, of its
herds, and of its men, of those now born, and of those yet to
be born, the holy, yea, for the furtherance of that house of which
these (men) are thus.
segments.zh: 我們在慶典中宣佈它們，使之對於此家、此家的繁榮更加有利，對於其畜群與其人民的繁榮有利，對於已生與將生者的繁榮有利，對於聖潔有利，是的，對於這些人所屬的那家的繁榮有利。
segments.note: SBE 此處未另譯；本節原文與 Y 4.5 逐字相同，英譯與中譯代入該節。

segments.orig:
âat dîsh âvaêdhayamahî ashâunãm
vanguhibyô fravashibyô ýå ukhråsca
aiwithûråsca ashaonãm avanghe.
segments.en:
And we make these known in our celebrations to the good Fravashis
of the saints which are formidable and overwhelming in their aid.
segments.zh:
我們在此慶典中使這些被知曉，致於善良的弗拉瓦希
聖者的弗拉瓦希，他們在援助上令人生畏且壓倒性。
segments.note: SBE 此處未另譯；本節原文與 Vr 11.15 逐字相同，英譯與中譯代入該節。

segments.orig:
âat dîsh âvaêdhayamahî dathushô
ahurahe mazdå raêvatô hvarenanguhatô mainyêush
mainyaoyehe ameshanãm speñtanãm ýasnâica
vahmâica xshnaothrâica frasastayaêca.
segments.en:
Yea, we present these hereby to the Creator Ahura Mazda, the
radiant, the glorious, and the heavenly spirit, for the sacrifice,
homage, propitiation, and praise of the Bountiful Immortals (all).
segments.zh: 是的，我們藉此將這些獻給造主阿胡拉‧馬茲達，光輝者、榮耀者，以及天界之靈，用於不朽聖者全體的祭祀、敬禮、祈求與讚美。
segments.note: SBE 此處未另譯；本節原文與 Y 4.7 逐字相同，英譯與中譯代入該節。

segments.orig:

ashahe ratubyô, hâvanêe ashaone ashahe rathwe
ýasnâica vahmâica xshnaothrâica frasastayaêca,
âat dîsh âvaêdhayamahî sâvanghêe
vîsyâica ... ...

... hâvanôish rathwô ýasnâica
vahmâica xshnaothrâica frasastayaêca!

âat dîsh âvaêdhayamahî (zôt
u râspî,) ahurahe mazdå raêvatô
hvarenanguhatô ameshanãm speñtanãm
... ...

... nabânazdishtanãm fravashinãm xshnaothra
ýasnâica vahmâica xshnaothrâica frasastayaêca!

âat dîsh âvaêdhayamahî ashâunãm
fravashinãm ukhranãm aiwithûranãm paoiryô-tkaêshanãm
fravashinãm nabânazdishtanãm fravashinãm

âat dîsh âvaêdhayamahî vîspaêibyô
ashahe ratubyô ýasnâica vahmâica xshnaothrâica
frasastayaêca, âat dîsh âvaêdhayamahî
vîspaêibyô vanghudhâbyô ýazataêibyô
mainyaoibyascâ gaêthyaêibyascâ ýôi
heñti ýasnyâca vahmyâca ashât
haca ýat vahishtât!!
